clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, sturdy bears yield hearts for the Royal Apothecary Society's research into the New Plague.

The Royal Apothecary Society works without pause to create an engineered blight that can exterminate both the Scourge and living humanity. In Silverpine Forest's woodlands, Apothecary Renferrel found that toxins from a grizzled bear's heart make a remarkably lethal concoction when joined with arachnid ichor. Couriers and Forsaken loyalists hunt ferocious grizzled bears, giant grizzled bears, and the roaming beast Old Vicejaw. They carve out the hearts and carry them to Master Apothecary Faranell, deep within the Undercity's Apothecarium.
